status_note: Approved for development on 7 Nov 2026 (P-01). Pending clinical approval and an MHRA medical-device scope assessment. Not approved for public launch.

questions.text: Are you currently experiencing any of the following: chest pain suggesting a heart attack, severe difficulty breathing, signs of a stroke, collapse, severe bleeding, a severe allergic reaction, or immediate danger of serious self-harm?
Have you recently taken more medicine than prescribed, taken the wrong medicine, or made a medication mistake that you think could be dangerous?
Are you requesting this review because of a new or worsening medicine-related problem or symptom that you think may need urgent medical attention?
Have you run out of, missed, or been unable to obtain an essential medicine, and are you concerned this could cause harm before you can receive medical advice?
